description.zh: 在开满小花的草地上，一起慢慢长大。
description.en: A little meadow where your companion can grow.

description.zh: 月亮和星星陪伴的小小营地。
description.en: A quiet campsite beneath the moon and stars.

description.zh: 听海浪轻轻拍打温暖的沙滩。
description.en: Gentle waves meet a warm sandy shore.

description.zh: 窗边洒满阳光，今天也有新的进步。
description.en: A sunlit classroom for another day of progress.

description.zh: 红灯笼照亮小院，和伙伴迎接新的开始。
description.en: Red lanterns welcome a fresh beginning in a cozy courtyard.

description.zh: 沿着亮起花灯的街巷，收藏团圆的暖意。
description.en: Follow a glowing lantern lane and celebrate togetherness.

description.zh: 细雨拂过柳枝，在青山与春草间轻轻漫步。
description.en: Soft rain falls on willows and a peaceful green spring landscape.

description.zh: 粽叶清香飘过河岸，远处龙舟划开碧水。
description.en: Dragon boats glide past a riverside scented with bamboo leaves.

description.zh: 星光在银河上铺成小桥，送来温柔的祝愿。
description.en: A starlit bridge stretches across the Milky Way with gentle wishes.

description.zh: 一盏盏河灯静静漂流，让思念在水面发光。
description.en: Quiet river lanterns carry warm memories across the water.

description.zh: 桂花树下月色正好，一起分享团圆时光。
description.en: Share a peaceful reunion beneath the full moon and osmanthus.

description.zh: 秋日登高望远，山间菊花正盛开。
description.en: Climb an autumn hillside lined with blooming chrysanthemums.

description.zh: 窗外雪花轻落，屋里一碗腊八粥暖暖的。
description.en: A warm bowl of Laba porridge brightens a snowy winter day.

description.zh: 五星红旗映着大红庆典与金色花坛，共庆金秋。
description.en: The five-star red flag overlooks a vivid red celebration and golden flowerbeds.

description.zh: 给花圃浇一点水，向每一份认真劳动致意。
description.en: Tend a growing garden and celebrate every caring effort.

description.zh: 气球和风筝飞起来，让童心在草地上奔跑。
description.en: Balloons and kites make a playful meadow full of wonder.

description.zh: 把鲜花放在书桌上，感谢每一份耐心陪伴。
description.en: Flowers on a classroom desk thank every patient, caring teacher.

name.en: Lunar New Year’s Eve · Reunion night

description.zh: 年夜饭香气满满，在烟花与钟声中一起守岁。
description.en: A reunion dinner, fireworks and midnight chimes welcome the Lunar New Year.

description.zh: 糖瓜摆上灶台，扫去旧尘，迎接满屋春意。
description.en: Sweet sugar melons and a freshly swept kitchen prepare a warm home for spring.

description.zh: 祥龙昂首穿过春云，把新的希望带到大地。
description.en: An auspicious dragon lifts its head through spring clouds, bringing fresh hope.

description.zh: 冬窗映着白雪，一盘饺子和一碗汤圆传递团圆暖意。
description.en: Dumplings and sweet rice balls bring reunion warmth beside a snowy winter window.

description.zh: 带上铁锹和水壶，种下一株绿意与未来。
description.en: Plant a sapling with a shovel and watering can, growing a greener future.

description.zh: 五四书卷映着朝阳，纸飞机载着青春梦想向前。
description.en: May Fourth books and a rising sun send youthful dreams soaring on paper planes.

description.zh: 七一晨光照亮红旗与城市，记录共同走过的时光。
description.en: July First sunlight brightens red flags and the city, marking a shared history.

description.zh: 八一红旗映着青山，和平鸽展翅飞向晴空。
description.en: August First red flags frame green hills as peace doves spread their wings.

name.zh: 中国农民丰收节 · 金秋满仓
name.en: Chinese Farmers’ Harvest Festival · Golden granary

description.zh: 金黄稻穗铺满田野，把一年的辛勤收进谷仓。
description.en: Golden rice fields and a full granary celebrate a year of farmers’ care.

description.zh: 冬夜的钟声响起，在烟花下写下新的期待。
description.en: Winter chimes and fireworks welcome a year of new hopes.

description.zh: 玫瑰沿着花门盛开，让温柔心意被看见。
description.en: Roses bloom around a garden arch for a day of warm affection.

description.zh: 含羞草与紫花迎来春天，为每一种成长喝彩。
description.en: Mimosa and violet blossoms celebrate every kind of growth.

description.zh: 珍惜森林与清澈水岸，守护共同的小小星球。
description.en: Care for forests, clear rivers and the planet we share.

description.zh: 打开一本书，在安静的角落遇见新的世界。
description.en: Open a book and discover a new world in a quiet reading nook.

name.zh: 母亲节 · 康乃馨花房

description.zh: 花房里开满康乃馨，把感谢送给温暖的照顾。
description.en: A greenhouse of carnations offers thanks for loving care.

description.zh: 带上野餐篮和手工风筝，收藏相伴的好时光。
description.en: Share a picnic, a handmade kite and a little time together.

description.zh: 在春草和花篮旁，发现藏着的小彩蛋。
description.en: Find colorful eggs among spring grass and flower baskets.

description.zh: 南瓜灯点亮温和月夜，一起享受秋日小冒险。
description.en: Friendly pumpkin lanterns light a gentle autumn-night adventure.

description.zh: 麦穗与南瓜装满庭院，记住值得感谢的小事。
description.en: A courtyard of wheat and pumpkins celebrates things to be thankful for.

description.zh: 杉树、礼物与暖窗，在雪夜里分享节日惊喜。
description.en: Fir trees, gifts and glowing windows brighten a snowy festive night.

name.zh: 圣帕特里克节 · 三叶草溪谷

description.zh: 三叶草点缀绿色溪谷，带着好心情去散步。
description.en: Shamrocks line a green stream valley for a cheerful spring walk.

description.zh: 小油灯与彩色花纹点亮庭院，迎接光明和祝愿。
description.en: Small diyas and colorful rangoli brighten a courtyard with hope.

description.zh: 月光下的灯廊温暖明亮，分享团聚的喜悦。
description.en: A glowing moonlit arcade welcomes the joy of gathering together.

description.zh: 九枝灯映亮冬日窗边，让温暖与希望相伴。
description.en: A nine-branched hanukkiah fills a winter window with warmth and hope.
